metric: Pairs proved equivalent by the z3 prover over all databases meeting the declared keys and NOT NULL columns, with no LLM. Inequivalent pairs stay out of this count.
correctness: 0 false proofs: every proof survives 1,000 further random DuckDB databases and VeriEQL's published counterexamples replayed on DuckDB
caveats: Pairs carry no labels; wrongness is checked against VeriEQL's published counterexamples and a second random search. 14 of the 64 pairs differ between our file and VeriEQL's published outcomes file and were not audited. Developed against these pairs (tuned on test). Whole-row predicates (B1(X)) are spelled out over the row's columns; DuckDB runs them as a fixed hashed macro and the prover as uninterpreted functions. Two pairs write a set operation of bare table names, (R UNION ALL S); the harness spells them as (SELECT * FROM R UNION ALL SELECT * FROM S) so they parse (adapted cases). Measured on master 80ac740, after the structural aggregate rules (src/kumosql/aggregate_rules.py, #371). Re-measured on master 4d294afd (sqlglot 30.21, z3-solver 5.1.0.0, an otherwise idle 4-core machine): 24 to 28 proved, 0 wrong. Whether the gain comes from rules merged since 2026-10-02 or from solver timeouts that no longer fire on an idle machine was not separated.
